role.title: Senior Data Scientist
role.requirements:
US Foster City / Bay Area preferred (California OK). PRIORITY HIRE — hands-on Senior Data Scientist for real-time digital performance analytics. NOT slide-deck DS, NOT research-only, NOT pure SWE without ML depth.

Must have: PhD in CS/Stats/related OR MS + 5+ years applied ML/data science.

Technical foundation:
- Traditional ML: regression, classification, ensembles, clustering, dimensionality reduction
- Deep learning: CNNs, RNNs/LSTMs, Transformers, attention — as the problem demands
- Statistical modeling: optimization, Bayesian / probabilistic methods
- Time series: forecasting, change-point detection, seasonality; anomaly detection & automated alerting
- Python (primary) production code; Scala a plus
- Ship POC → scalable integrated ML in production systems
- Large-scale data: Ray and/or Spark

AI-native developer: habitual Claude / Cursor / Copilot use for coding, debugging, design — not just awareness.

Bonus: streaming / real-time analytics; AI-powered alerting / intelligent monitoring; MLOps (versioning, monitoring, retraining); LLM/foundation models in analytical workflows.

Score HIGH when: production ML + time series/anomaly/alerting + Ray/Spark or MLOps.
Score LOW / DISQUALIFY: pure analyst dashboards; academic-only with no production; tutorial/student; SWE with no modeling depth; generic 'AI enthusiast' bios.
